record.question: Sahitya Akademy Award 2015 was awarded to
record.explanation: The Akademi's 2016 award-presentation programme lists its 2015 winners, including Ramdarash Mishra (Hindi). None of the other named choices is in that list. Printed Ramdash is a spelling defect; category omission alone does not defeat the uniquely intended option D. Require visible spelling correction/note. Historical exam context: 2016-10 (month/year printed). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://sahitya-akademi.gov.in/pdf/festival_15-20-feb-16.pdf Independently checked solution, unofficial. No matching examiner answer key is asserted.
